stem.text: The graph shows the variation with distance along the wave of the displacement of water particles at a particular instant in time for a transverse water wave.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement in m (vertical axis, -4 to 4) against distance in m (horizontal axis, 0 to 24) showing a wave curve with points labelled P, Q and R on the curve.

stem.text: P, Q and R show the positions of three water particles in the wave.
Which particle has the greatest speed at the instant shown?
